title: A current represented by (M, θ, ξ) vanishes on every set of zero weight θH^n⌞M
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, let W ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set, let T ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n, and let R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep U n with R.Represents T, i.e. T(ω) = R.action(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·ξ(x)(ω(x)) dH^n(x) for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n. If R.measure(W) = 0, where R.measure = (H^n⌞M).withDensity θ, then T vanishes on W: T(ω) = 0 for every ω ∈ TestFormOn U n with tsupport ω ⊆ W.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), R.Represents T → R.measure W = 0 → T.VanishesOn W
